title: An Indian Earbuds Brand Just Made a Phone

beats.say: Mivi, the Indian earbuds brand, just made its first phone.
This is the Mivi One Five G.
Here's the interesting part. It runs plain Android sixteen.
No bloatware. And Mivi promises two big updates, all the way to Android eighteen.
And yes, an earbuds company kept the headphone jack.
Inside, there's a Snapdragon four Gen two, built on a four nanometre process.
A six thousand milliamp hour battery, in a body just nine point one five millimetres thin.
And the charger is still in the box.
The main camera is a fifty megapixel Samsung Isocell sensor, with an f one point eight lens.
The six point seven five inch screen is an HD plus LCD. That's seven twenty p, at four hundred and fifty nits.
And charging tops out at eighteen watts.
Mivi is also betting on service. Five hundred plus service centres, and free pickup and drop across nineteen thousand plus pin codes.
It starts at thirteen thousand nine hundred and ninety nine rupees on Flipkart, with a hundred and twenty eight G B in every model, in five colours.
So Mivi took a budget phone, cleared out the junk apps, kept the headphone jack, and built it in Hyderabad.
